Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

mxHelper 0.0.4

New features

  • MxHelperIsGoodFit() and .MxHelperIsGoodFit() gain nd_tol (default 1e-4): a fit that fails the gradient test (grad_tol) is still good when its Newton decrement g' H^{-1} g is below nd_tol and its Hessian is positive definite. The test does not depend on the scale of the parameters, so a converged fit with a near-zero variance (a gradient of about 0.05 on its coefficients) is no longer sent to a rescue. nd_tol = NULL or 0 gives the old behaviour.
  • TRUE from MxHelperIsGoodFit() has the attribute criterion: "gradient" or "newton". isTRUE() and if () ignore it.
  • nd_tol is passed on by MxHelperNeedsRescue(), MxHelperRun(), MxHelperEnsureGoodHessian(), MxHelperReadRunSave(), and their internal versions.

mxHelper 0.0.3

Patch

  • MxHelperSigmaFixed() and .MxHelperSigmaFixed() now use values and type: they read uc_d and s_l from .MxHelperLDL() (they read names it does not return, so the matrix was always the identity).
  • MxHelperDiagMxMatrix() and .MxHelperDiagMxMatrix() with vec = FALSE return the matrix only (they stopped with an mxMatrix() error).
  • The # nolint comments on the headers of the ten SigmaFromLDL and SigmaDiagFromLDL files no longer run over 80 characters.

mxHelper 0.0.2

Patch

  • Removed every return() from the nine internal functions that used it (.MxHelperEnsureGoodHessian(), .MxHelperNeedsRescue(), .MxHelperHasPdHessian(), .MxHelperIsGoodFit(), .MxHelperRun(), .MxHelperQuiet(), .RobustSE(), .MxHelperRelaxBounds(), .MxHelperRelaxBoundsAtBounds()): early exits became if/else branches with the same results; the 236 tests of push 1 pass unchanged.
  • Tests for the 15 input-check functions (.CheckCodes() to .CheckVal()).
  • Lines wrapped to 80 characters, nolint lists completed (object_length_linter).

mxHelper 0.0.1

Patch

  • First release as a package: the rProject template, complete roxygen, and an exported version with input checks of each of the 58 functions.
  • Tests for every function, on the code as imported.
  • The two files that held two functions are split (mxHelper-inv-softplus-dot.R, mxHelper-inv-ldl-dot.R); mxHelper-force-hessian-options.R is now -dot.R, and mxHelper-check-status-code-dot.R is mxHelper-status-code-check.R.
